tickets.title: Third Avenue L stop closure pilot proposal
tickets.summary: A public speaker and software engineer simulated closing every NYC subway stop using MTA trip data and found that closing the Third Avenue L stop would save riders significant time because only about 5% of riders board or leave there. He noted the stop is not a transfer station or wheelchair accessible. Action: Refer the Third Avenue stop closure idea to the transportation committee and ask the MTA about piloting a closure.
